Message from a parent
---------------------

Our older son (9) had exome sequencing last year and they found a change in SYNGAP1 that
they said was definitely the cause. It was new in him, not from either of us.

Our younger daughter is 4. She's meeting all her milestones and nobody has raised any
concerns about her at nursery. But I keep thinking — what if she has it too and we just
can't see it yet? I'd rather know now.

Can you write me a request to get her tested for the same thing? We're in England.
